def solution():
    # Define variables name and value
    shares = 200_000
    price_per_share_eur = 90
    euro_notional = shares * price_per_share_eur

    initial_spot_bid = 1.3935
    initial_six_month_forward_points_bid = -0.0190
    initial_forward_rate = initial_spot_bid + initial_six_month_forward_points_bid

    three_month_spot_ask = 1.4210
    three_month_three_month_forward_points_ask = -0.0210
    current_forward_rate = three_month_spot_ask + three_month_three_month_forward_points_ask

    usd_libor = 0.01266
    remaining_time = 3 / 12

    # Do math calculation to get the answer
    usd_value_at_maturity = euro_notional * (initial_forward_rate - current_forward_rate)
    mark_to_market_value = usd_value_at_maturity / (1 + usd_libor * remaining_time)

    # return answer
    return round(mark_to_market_value, 3)
